concept.description: Two broad card uprights with steep outward-folded edges stand above a low terracotta shelf. Pale laminated cores show at the cut edges. The central space stays open across the entire top, replacing the earlier near-enclosing upper tips.
concept.metaphor_text: Independently contributed parts make an accessible shared team library

assumptions: These are authored alternatives for visual evaluation; owner artistic acceptance remains unknown

details.construction: Each card assembly uses three touching layers, measured along z: a colored back from 0 to 0.006, a pale paper core from 0.006 to 0.030, and a colored face from 0.030 to 0.036, offset together along the authored plane. The layers meet at their faces with no gap.
details.deletion_test: Without the pale core the substantial cut edge loses its paper-laminate cue
details.intended_scale: Hero and native detail; not a separate favicon feature
details.purpose: Make heavyweight paper stock visible through a pale core rather than a uniformly colored slab

details.construction: For each upright layer the broad face meets its outer return on x=-0.82 (mirrored for the right). Both surfaces have z=0.08 plus the same layer offset at this edge. The face and return are boolean-unioned into one watertight PLY before rendering. The return turns outward, away from the central opening.
details.deletion_test: Without the return there is no intentional paper fold; without the open top the object becomes an enclosing badge-like frame
details.intended_scale: Hero; primary projected contour remains in the SVG master
details.purpose: Make changes of plane legible and keep the central shared space open

details.construction: The lower terracotta shelf is a separate card assembly. Its two wings turn upward along y=-0.6, where both plane formulas have the same height. No structural fastening to the uprights is claimed; small air gaps are intentional separation between the three logo parts.
details.deletion_test: Without the low shared shelf the uprights read as unrelated panels
details.intended_scale: Hero and the broad flat silhouette
details.purpose: Suggest a usable shared library space while keeping three contributed parts distinct

plan.hypothesis: An open shared team library formed by independently contributed parts
plan.visual_mechanism: Two broad card uprights with steep outward-folded edges stand above a low terracotta shelf. Pale laminated cores show at the cut edges. The central space stays open across the entire top, replacing the earlier near-enclosing upper tips.

business.audience: Teammates with mixed technical confidence, including newcomers discovering and using AI skills; Builders and trusted approvers maintain the shared library.
business.name: Skill Swap
business.summary: A private team workspace for reusable AI skills and plugins. Individual contributions become shared capability through a clear library, independent review and approved releases. The promise is: Your team's know-how, ready to use. The visual identity is warm and editorial. The dimensional logo MUST be built from layered heavyweight paper or card, with broad geometric pieces, controlled folds, substantial thickness, visible edges and restrained fiber texture. Explore three distinct territories: joined modules, a folded shared object, and parts framing an open shared space.

requirements.communication_priority: A team’s contributed AI know-how becomes an accessible shared library

avoid: Any non-paper material including ceramic, porcelain, metal, rubber, glass, wax or clay
A badge, medallion, backing disc or frame
Generic AI sparkles, chain links or recycling arrows
Slack hashtag or Dropbox diamond-box topology
Cohere cell cluster and Miro chevrons
Fine text or hairline geometry inside the symbol
Confusing peer-to-peer skill barter with a team AI skills library

open_choices: Symbol construction within the stated material intent
